resources.string: What this report means
The last URL check passed. This is not continuous monitoring.
The last attempt did not pass. The code describes an observation, not a proven cause.
Check time: %1$s
This is a snapshot. A running VPN and idle zero counters do not prove either Internet access or a fault. Send the report if a problem recurs.
If sites still fail, note what does not open and send the report; one successful test does not check every destination.
First check the date, time and time zone on the TV. Keep certificate validation enabled; repeat the check and send the report if it fails again.
Do not disable certificate verification or change server settings blindly. Run extended checks, then send the report. This code alone does not identify the failing TLS peer.
Check that the TV has a network connection. Compare ordinary browsing, then run extended checks. Do not publish your network addresses or configuration.
A previous check is still finishing. Wait before retrying; this does not mean that the VPN itself is broken.
This profile or transport may not be supported by this build. Send the report; no silent protocol replacement is performed.
The profile or connection changed during the check. Run it again for the current profile.
Repeat once if convenient. If the issue persists, run extended checks and use Report to smartphone. The VPN will not be switched by these actions.
A TLS certificate time check failed. Check the device clock; the certificate may also be expired or not yet valid. The exact TLS peer is not established by this code alone.
The connection check did not complete successfully. The cause is not established. This is a connection report, not proof of a subscription download failure.

passed

These checks use Android networking and separate test cores, not a trace of every stage inside the running VPN. A skipped TCP/TLS stage can be normal for QUIC/REALITY. Technical evidence follows.
Short QR without Wi-Fi

No network is needed for this QR: it contains a short text summary, not a link or the full TXT. Scan with the phone camera or a QR reader, copy the text and send it manually. Local sharing is now closed. For the full report, reopen sharing on the same trusted network.
Link active: %1$d s left. Report responses sent: %2$d. Check the saved file on the phone.
The server address could not be resolved. Check the device network and DNS. This alone does not prove that the profile credentials are wrong.
The profile or physical network changed during the check. The old result does not describe the current connection; repeat the check.
